texts.preamble: S.Vijayalakshmi vs The Director Of Town And Country ... on 10 July, 2025 Author: J.Nisha Banu Bench: J. Nisha Banu 1/6 W In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 10-07-2025 Coram The Honourable Mrs Justice J. Nisha Banu And The Honourable Mr.Justice M.Jothiraman W.P. No. 24902 of 2025 S.Vijayalakshmi ..Vs.. 1. The Director of Town and Country Planning Office of the Director of Town and Country Planning 2nd, 3rd & 4th Floor, C & E Market Road Koyambedu, Chennai-600 107. 2.The Joint Director District Town and Country Planning st nd 1 and 2 Floor Door No.50, Fci Road Gandhi Maanagar Ganapathy, Coimbatore-641 004 3.The Commissioner Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation Big Bazaar Street, Town Hall Coimbatore-641 001. 4.The Assistant Commissioner Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation (West Zone) Coimbatore, S.Vijayalakshmi vs The Director Of Town And Country ... on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185168938/ 1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 15/07/2025 01:31:06 pm ) 2/6 5. The Executive Engineer (Planning) Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation Coimbatore. 6.Manikandan Prayer:
texts.facts: This writ petition is filed for a Mandamus, directing the 4th respondent to consider the petitioner's representation dated 15.05.2025, and to take action to demolish the illegal and unauthorised construction put up by the 6th respondent on the land bearing SF No.393/2 situate at Anupparpalayam Village, Coimbatore Town, Coimbatore, located at the address Door No.40, Senguptha Street, Ram Nagar, Coimbatore, without any building approval and planning https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 15/07/2025 01:31:06 pm ) permission and in violation of the provisions of Tamil Nadu Combined Development Building Rules 2019 and Tamil Nadu Town and Country Planning Act, 1971, within a time as fixed by this Court. 2. It is the case of the petitioner that he is the owner and occupier of the the residential premises bearing Door No.41, Senguptha Street, Ramnagar, Coimbatore-641 009, situated in T.S No.393, Anupparpalayam Village, Coimbatore. The 6th respondent is the owner of the adjacent property in T.S.No.393/2 and is presently carrying out large scale construction activities with a proposed built-up area exceeding 2000 square feet, without obtaining any sanction or approval from the competent authorities. The said construction is being undertaken without leaving the mandatory side setbacks and rear setbacks as required under the Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules, 2019, thereby posing a direct threat to the safety, ventilation, access rights of the other neighbouring residents including the petitioner. Hence, the petitioner has sent a representation dated 15.05.2025 to the 4th respondent requesting to take action and to demolish the S.Vijayalakshmi vs The Director Of Town And Country ... on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185168938/ 2 said unauthorised construction. But, the official respondents did not take any action on the petitioner's representation. Therefore, the petitioner is constrained to move the present Writ Petition.
